body:
Good morning, Bakersfield. It’s Monday, August 24, 2026, and we’re starting the week with a high near 105° and air quality at a moderate 63. Overnight, a violent dispute at a wellness facility in southwest Bakersfield and a brush fire in unincorporated Kern County kept emergency crews busy. Our top story today is the arrest of a 15-year-old in connection with a deadly shooting at Friday’s Independence High School football game. Let’s get you caught up.

## The Kern Overnight

A dispute at a wellness facility in southwest Bakersfield turned violent late Saturday night when a roommate reportedly poured hot water on another resident, bringing officers to the scene. Fire crews in the county were also kept busy with a brush fire that drew dozers and two battalions, and police handled a domestic call on Riverlakes Drive and a welfare check on Beardsley Avenue through the early hours.

## Today's weather

Today’s forecast calls for a high near 105° and a low around 75° tonight. It’s currently 75° at Meadows Field (KBFL). We’re under no active weather alerts for Kern County. Air quality is moderate at 63, and fire crews are on one active fire in Kern — the Alper Fire.

## Top stories

**23ABC reports that Cal State Bakersfield has launched its first mariachi ensemble.** Jorge Laris, the mariachi director at Arvin High School, is taking on a new role as a lecturer at CSUB to lead the program. The ensemble meets Tuesday evenings from 7 to 10 p.m., and Laris is encouraging students of all backgrounds to sign up and learn to play mariachi music. This new musical group will add to the cultural richness of the local community.

**Bakersfield Now reports that a 15-year-old was arrested in connection with a deadly shooting at Friday’s Independence High School football game.** The incident has shaken the Bakersfield neighborhood near the school. The suspect was arrested miles away from the scene. KHSD superintendent released a statement following the shooting, and Bakersfield Mayor Karen Goh also released a statement on the incident.

**23ABC reports that McFarland police are investigating a homicide after a 26-year-old man was shot and killed Saturday afternoon at the Capri Laundromat in the 100 block of Perkins Avenue.** Officers responded to the scene at approximately 3:18 p.m. and found the man suffering from multiple gunshot wounds inside the laundromat. Officers immediately provided medical aid and initiated CPR, but the victim was pronounced dead at the scene. Preliminary information indicates two unknown suspects arrived at the Capri Liquors in the 100 block of Perkins Avenue and confronted the victim inside the Capri Laundromat, which is adjacent to the gas pumps. An argument led to one of the suspects producing a firearm and shooting the victim multiple times. The two suspects then fled the area in an unknown vehicle. No suspects have been identified, no arrests have been made, and the motive remains unknown. The victim's identity will be released after next of kin have been notified. McFarland Police Department detectives are actively working the scene and gathering investigative information. Police say there is no current threat to the community, but the public is advised to avoid the area until the scene is processed. Anyone with information about this investigation is asked to call Detective Galvan or Detective Cazares at 661-792-2121.

## Something good

Cal State Bakersfield has launched its first mariachi ensemble. This new musical group will add to the cultural richness of the local community.

## Coming up this week

This week, the Bakersfield City Council has a busy schedule. On Wednesday, August 26, there will be a Special City Council Meeting at 12:00 p.m., followed by City Council Meeting 330 at 3:30 p.m. and City Council Meeting 515 at 5:15 p.m. On the entertainment front, the Fox Theater has several events lined up. On Tuesday, August 24, you can purchase a Cults & Classics: Season Pass 2026-2027. On Friday, August 27, Rodney Carrington will perform. On Saturday, August 28, CUMBIATRON: THE CUMBIA RAVE will take the stage. On Sunday, August 29, Willie Barcena and Michael Return Of The King Tribute Featuring Michael Phoenix will both perform. Finally, on Saturday, September 4, the MI HISTORIA TOUR LEYENDAS DEL MARIACHI USA will be at the Fox Theater.
